findings.asked: Simplify an algebraic fraction involving a difference of two squares and a division.
findings.wentWrong: The common denominator was found but the numerator's difference of two squares was missed; cancellation caused problems; several left 3x(x - 2)/x as the answer.
findings.rule: Simplify until no common factor remains.

findings.asked: Factorise and cancel to simplify a fraction.
findings.wentWrong: Most factorised and cancelled, but a high number missed the remaining factor of 2.
findings.rule: Check the numerical factor at the end.

ruleToRemember: Factorise fully (common factor, difference of two squares, quadratic), cancel whole factors, and check the answer for any remaining common factor including numbers.
